decisions.reason: Because the fifteen-day express offer still fits the core business and is cheap to maintain as a sales option in a growing market, management would keep it despite some rationalization risk from overlap with other express programs.

The seventy-two-hour express program remains a differentiated but adjacent offer whose value has not been disproven, so its option value still exceeds the likely carrying cost even if operational demands are higher.
As a broader express product line with its own page in both years, it appears to be an established growth platform close to the firm’s capabilities and worth retaining.

The online ordering and digital services platform supports the firm’s strategic move toward deeper service and advisory integration, so dropping it would sacrifice a promising option with strong complementarities.

The fire and smoke protection door gained prominence from 2023 to 2024 and matches the firm’s strength in safety-compliant customized solutions, indicating favorable resolved prospects and low likelihood of withdrawal.
